text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, our guest City-san will 
be spending some time surviving on an 
uninhabited island~!”

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
Now then, City-san. If you could only 
bring one single item to a deserted 
island, what would you choose?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Just one, was it?

text_block_list.name: City on TV
text_block_list.text: "Well then, Trainer. Here's my—"

text_block_list.name: TV Program Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Today's shoot isn't about the hardcore 
reality of survival, but rather about 
capturing a person's true self within a 
unique environment—"

text_block_list.name: TV Program Staff
text_block_list.text:
During filming, you'll need to follow the 
instructor's directions, but other than 
that, you're free to spend your time as 
you please.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And that's that. So we can sneak in some 
training in between, right?
choice_data_list: I see, so that's why you said "ore"...
I see, so that's why you said "watashi"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must devise a menu that makes full use 
of this deserted island's environment, no 
matter what!
choice_data_list: なるほど、だから『俺』か……
なるほど、だから『私』か……
choice_data_list_en: I see, so that's why you meant 'me'...
I see, so that's why you meant 'me'...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
In an environment like this, I have to be 
careful with skincare and moisturizing, 
but... I wonder what's around here?
choice_data_list: シチーの期待に応えてみせる！
choice_data_list_en: I'll live up to City's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That coconut I picked up earlier... Well, 
looks like we could use it for oil at 
least.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
“...Whoa, the sun's harsh. I wonder if 
that leaf over there could work as a 
parasol?”

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What do you think this is? ...Impromptu 
potpourri. I stuffed some flowers into a 
container I found lying around, and it 
turned out surprisingly nice.

text_block_list.name: TV Program Staff
text_block_list.text:
Cut! That's wonderful~ From a modeling 
perspective, deserted island life really 
pops!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, hah, The footing is terrible...! 
The strain is brutal...!
choice_data_list: Keep going! One more to go!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright...! Time to spurt...!
choice_data_list: 頑張れ！ラストあと一本！
choice_data_list_en: Hang in there! Just one last rep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Living a deserted island life worthy of a 
model, fitting in training whenever 
possible. The photoshoot progressed 
smoothly. However—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What is this? There's no one here. No 
gear, no boat...!
choice_data_list: Is something wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, did they really have to leave us 
behind? Or are things so bad they didn't 
even notice we were gone...?"
choice_data_list: 何かトラブルかな……？
choice_data_list_en: Could there be some trouble...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
My phone is... still out of service, just 
like when we arrived. Living on a deserted 
island like this is no joke, you know.
choice_data_list: No, I'll definitely find a way back home.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, we've got nothing on 
us. It's not like we have any leads.
choice_data_list: いや、なんとか帰る方法を見つけてみせるよ
choice_data_list_en: No, I'll definitely find a way for us to get back.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ――…… Ugh, talk about overbearing.
choice_data_list: そうだけど君の夢を途絶えさせはしない！
そうだけど貴方の夢を途絶えさせはしない！
choice_data_list_en: That may be so, but I won't let your dream end!
That may be so, but I won't let your dream end!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, sure, of course I wanna keep 
running in races, but still."
choice_data_list:
It's not too late to reach a conclusion 
after you've struggled a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ............ Well, you have a point.
choice_data_list: 結論を出すのは足掻いてからでも遅くないよ
choice_data_list_en: It won't be too late to reach a conclusion after putting up a fight.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Understood. No matter the situation, 
conditioning our bodies is a must, right?
choice_data_list: とにかくトレーニングは続けよう
まずは生き抜くことを優先しないと……
こんな時こそ娯楽は忘れちゃいけない！
choice_data_list_en: Anyway, let's keep training.
First, we have to prioritize just surviving...
Times like these are when we shouldn't forget to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Sounds good. If we get creative, we 
might even be able to set up a whole 
course, right?
choice_data_list: 流木やツタを使えば、器具も作れそうだな！
流木やツタを使えば、器具も作れそうだね！
choice_data_list_en: If we use driftwood and vines, we could probably make equipment too!
If we use driftwood and vines, we could probably make equipment too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... phew. I think it's finally 
starting to take shape.
choice_data_list: もちろん！いい場所を見つけよう！
choice_data_list_en: Of course! Let's find a great spot!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. Whether we wait for help or try 
to escape, it won't matter if we 
collapse."
choice_data_list:
First, let's make some daily necessities 
and a shelter.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Got it. Or so I'd like to say, but do you 
even know how to make it?
choice_data_list: とりあえず生活用具とシェルターを作ろうか
choice_data_list_en: For now, shall we make living tools and a shelter?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh. Well, let's see what you've got then.
choice_data_list: 来る前にサバイバル動画で予習したからね
choice_data_list_en: I prepped by watching survival videos before coming, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... phew. I think it's finally 
starting to take shape.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Recreation...? I thought you'd say 
something like, "First, let's get all the 
necessities together!"
choice_data_list:
Mental management is more important than 
you'd think.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yeah. To be honest, I almost 
panicked from the shock myself.
choice_data_list: メンタル管理は思った以上に重要だから
choice_data_list_en: Because mental management is more important than you'd think.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, what are you, a kid? ...Though, 
it's not bad."
choice_data_list: ブランコとか的当てとかなら作れそうだしさ
choice_data_list_en: We could probably make swings or target games, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... phew. I think it's finally 
starting to take shape.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the edge might need more 
reinforcement. Let me give it another go 
later.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, if we're doing this, let's go all 
the way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to being engrossed in the 
work, Gold City had completely regained 
her spirits. At this rate, the future is 
surely bright.
choice_data_list: うん、やるならとことんやろう！
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, if we're doing this, let's go all the way!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, pfft. You're completely covered in 
mud.
choice_data_list: That goes both ways.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah. Fans of 'Pretty City' might be 
pretty shocked if they saw this.
choice_data_list: それはお互い様だよ
choice_data_list_en: That goes both ways.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: いや、一生懸命な君はかっこいいよ
ううん、一生懸命な貴方はかっこいいよ
choice_data_list_en: No, you look cool when you're giving it your all.
No, you giving it your all is really cool.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still, the reason I became this way was—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
N-Nah, forget I said anything. I'm gonna 
go grab some water.
choice_data_list: Huh? Wait, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... That's not like me at all. What 
am I even saying?
choice_data_list: え？ちょっと、シチー？
choice_data_list_en: Huh? Wait, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...'The one thing you'd bring to an 
uninhabited island'—huh."

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text: Aaaand! Prank successful~~~!!

text_block_list.name: TV Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"Aah, sorry for startling you! But after 
seeing cool City-san burn with such 
passion, everyone's bound to fall in love 
with her all over again!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
............ ...I see. Thank you very 
much.
choice_data_list:
...I can't believe it was a hidden camera 
prank.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... let's just say it turned out 
okay. At least we can get back in one 
piece.
choice_data_list: ……まさかドッキリとは
choice_data_list_en: ...I never would've guessed it was a prank.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look at the unfinished fruit of our 
joint efforts. While one could simply 
chalk it up to a good memory, I can't help 
feeling a sense of regret.
choice_data_list: けど、どうせなら最後まで作りたかったかも
choice_data_list_en: Still, maybe I would've liked to make it all the way to the end.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. But they said it's about time to 
pack up.
choice_data_list:
I guess this is the end of our deserted 
island life, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it wasn't so bad after all. Though 
I'd hate being left behind.
choice_data_list: 無人島生活もこれでおしまいかぁ
choice_data_list_en: I guess our deserted island life is over now, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If there's no trouble, then coming back 
should be fine, right?
